# The run failure taxonomy (refactor plan step S15a; OpenV REQ-84): the class
# each runner finish site reports, the signals in a CLI's failure text that
# decide a failed run's class, and which classes the platform retries. Written
# by TestRunFailureTaxonomyGolden in internal/runner; the outcomes these
# produce are in outcomes.txt beside it. A refactor leaves this file
# byte-identical; a deliberate change regenerates it with
#   UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/mcp ./internal/runner -run TestRunFailureTaxonomyGolden

## finish sites (classifySite)
siteNoAdapter, no error -> provider_unavailable
siteWorkspacePrep, no error -> workspace
siteStartTransition, no error -> worker_error
siteAPIKeyMissing, no error -> auth
siteAdapterStart, "exec: not found" -> provider_unavailable
siteAdapterStart, "refused" (ErrAgentPolicy) -> agent_error
siteAdapterStart, "wrapped: refused" (ErrAgentPolicy) -> agent_error
siteAgentResult, no error -> ""
siteAgentResult, "exit status 1" -> agent_error
siteAgentExit, no error -> agent_error
siteTimeout, "context deadline exceeded" -> timeout
sitePanic, no error -> worker_error
siteAgentPolicy, no error -> agent_error
(a site with no case), no error -> worker_error

## auth signals, checked first (authSignals)
"401" -> auth
"403" -> auth
"api key" -> auth
"authenticated" -> auth
"authentication" -> auth
"credential" -> auth
"credentials" -> auth
"forbidden" -> auth
"invalid api key" -> auth
"invalid_api_key" -> auth
"login required" -> auth
"not logged in" -> auth
"permission denied" -> auth
"please log in" -> auth
"please login" -> auth
"sign in" -> auth
"unauthenticated" -> auth
"unauthorized" -> auth

## provider signals, checked second (providerSignals)
"429" -> provider_unavailable
"500" -> provider_unavailable
"502" -> provider_unavailable
"503" -> provider_unavailable
"504" -> provider_unavailable
"bad gateway" -> provider_unavailable
"capacity" -> provider_unavailable
"connection refused" -> provider_unavailable
"connection reset" -> provider_unavailable
"econnrefused" -> provider_unavailable
"gateway timeout" -> provider_unavailable
"internal server error" -> provider_unavailable
"network error" -> provider_unavailable
"network is unreachable" -> provider_unavailable
"no route to host" -> provider_unavailable
"overload" -> provider_unavailable
"overloaded" -> provider_unavailable
"quota" -> provider_unavailable
"rate limit" -> provider_unavailable
"rate_limit" -> provider_unavailable
"server error" -> provider_unavailable
"service unavailable" -> provider_unavailable
"temporarily unavailable" -> provider_unavailable
"usage limit" -> provider_unavailable

## rate-limit and overload signals, outranking a mention of an API key (throttleSignals)
"429" -> provider_unavailable
"capacity" -> provider_unavailable
"overload" -> provider_unavailable
"overloaded" -> provider_unavailable
"quota" -> provider_unavailable
"rate limit" -> provider_unavailable
"rate_limit" -> provider_unavailable
"usage limit" -> provider_unavailable

## failure texts (classifyAgentError: lower-cased, then a whole-word match)
"" -> ""
"exit status 1" -> agent_error
"Error: 401 Unauthorized" -> auth
"UNAUTHORIZED" -> auth
"Please Log In to continue" -> auth
"API Error: 429 Too Many Requests" -> provider_unavailable
"upstream connect error: Connection Reset by peer" -> provider_unavailable
"503 Service Unavailable: not logged in" -> auth
"rate limit exceeded; check your API key" -> provider_unavailable
"tool Read failed: wrote 403 lines" -> agent_error
"processed 1500 files before the tool failed" -> agent_error
"the network tool is disabled for this agent" -> agent_error
"Credentials file is missing a field the tool expects" -> auth
"panic: index out of range" -> agent_error

## classes the platform retries (agentruns.IsRetryableClass)
provider_unavailable -> true
auth -> false
workspace -> false
timeout -> true
agent_error -> false
worker_error -> true
"" -> false
